concerns.text: Success Criterion SC-001 references a GRPO baseline (Success_GRPO) but the specification contains no functional requirement that generates or records this baseline data. Without an FR to produce the GRPO success metric, the required comparison (Success_Student - Success_GRPO) ≥ 0.8 × (Success_Baseline - Success_GRPO) cannot be instantiated, making the criterion untestable.
